component.name: Maxima
component.summary: Free and open-source replacement for the EA Desktop launcher

description.p: Maxima signs in to your EA account, keeps your game library, downloads and updates games and starts them with the licence and EA environment they expect, without the EA Desktop client.

It ships a command line client, a background server that holds the logged-in session, and a protocol handler that answers link2ea://, origin2:// and qrc:// links opened by games and by the EA login page.
Games run through Wine or Proton; make sure a compatible runtime is available on your system.
